rules.title: Ban on discrimination against public assistance and housing subsidy recipients (source of income)
rules.requirement: Anyone providing rental accommodations may not discriminate against a person because they receive public assistance or a federal, state, or local housing subsidy (including rental assistance such as vouchers), or because of any requirement of that assistance or subsidy program.
rules.coverage_conditions: Any person furnishing rental accommodations in Massachusetts; protects recipients of federal, state, or local public assistance (including medical assistance) and tenants receiving housing subsidies or rental assistance.
rules.quoted_span: 10. For any person furnishing credit, services or rental accommodations to discriminate against any individual who is a recipient of federal, state, or local public assistance, including medical assistance, or who is a tenant receiving federal, state, or local housing subsidies, including rental assistance or rental supplements, because the individual is such a recipient, or because of any requirement of such public assistance, rental assistance, or housing subsidy program.

rules.title: Housing discrimination and prohibited applicant inquiries on protected characteristics
rules.requirement: Owners, managers, brokers and agents may not refuse to rent to, discriminate against, or make written or oral inquiries or records about a prospective tenant's race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, ancestry, marital status, veteran/military status, or handicap.
rules.coverage_conditions: Publicly assisted, multiple dwelling, contiguously located, and other covered housing accommodations in Massachusetts and persons with the right to rent or lease them, including agents and condo/co-op associations.
rules.exemptions: Subsection 7 does not apply to leasing a single unit in a two-family dwelling where the owner occupies the other unit; 'age' protections do not apply to minors or certain elderly housing developments.
rules.quoted_span: (c) to cause to be made any written or oral inquiry or record concerning the race, color, religious creed, national origin, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, which shall not include persons whose sexual orientation involves minor children as the sex object, age, genetic information, ancestry, marital status, veteran status or membership in the armed services, blindness, hearing impairment or other handicap or because such person possesses a trained dog guide as a consequence of blindness or hearing impairment, of the person seeking to rent or lease or buy any such accommodation or land;
rules.conflict_note: General fair housing protected-class provision; mapped to screening_restrictions because it bars applicant inquiries and refusals to rent.

rules.title: Ban on refusing to rent to households with children
rules.requirement: Landlords and their agents may not refuse to rent to, or discriminate in terms against, a person because a child or children will occupy the premises, subject to lawful occupancy limits.
rules.coverage_conditions: Publicly assisted, multiple dwelling, contiguously located and other covered housing accommodations in Massachusetts.
rules.exemptions: Dwellings of three apartments or less where one apartment is occupied by an elderly (65+) or infirm person for whom children would be a hardship; temporary leasing (up to one year) of an owner's principal residence; leasing a unit in an owner-occupied two-family dwelling.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Exemption for small dwellings depends on an elderly or infirm occupant for whom children would be a hardship; temporary leasing exemption depends on owner absence.
